puzzle._note: Assemble (op 2 on any part) opens dwarf_rock_schematics (113) with its control panel (114) in the side modal. Varps if1-if3 select pieces 1-3, if4-if6 show them. Each move is 5 pixels for every selected piece (paper_move; the recorded right moves had no sound), rotate steps every selected piece's sequence rot1 -> rot2 -> rot3 -> rot4 -> rot1 (paper_turn). Solved, the pieces snap onto their places, the borders hide, the congratulations layer shows, the varps go to 0, varbit dwarfrock_schematics_solved is set, the jingle plays and the four parts become the assembled schematic in the first part's slot. Ticks 2697-2809.
puzzle._tolerance: Ours: how close a piece must be. The capture solved with pieces 2, 6 and 5 pixels from these places (2795); 6 is the smallest that fits it.

landings._note: Fired into the rock: the player lands on one of two recorded spots (picked at random here) and flies three tiles' worth (dwarfrock_cannon_flying, fly_and_land), the camera above. Ticks 3282-3295, 3728-3738, 5276-5285.

exits._note: Taking the helmet off inside lands at 2825,10171 (tick 3679); the Avatar's death at 2824,10171 (tick 5751).

timer._note: dwarfrock_inside_timeleft starts at 800 as the last intro box is continued and drops by 25 every 25 ticks; each message comes as it reaches its value (ticks 3350-4479, 5288-5748). The 75/50/25/0 texts are the Wiki's (Between a Rock... transcript); no capture reaches them.
messages: The helmet seems to become even heavier...
You feel a headache coming on... oh wait, it's just your helmet.
You feel like you're being pushed into the ground by the weight of the golden helmet.
You stumble and nearly fall. You can only keep this helmet on for a few more minutes!
You fight the urge to take off your helmet. It's getting harder and harder to resist!

You don't think you can keep on this helmet for more than a minute.
Whatever you want to accomplish here, do it fast!
The weight of the helmet is becoming unbearable. You can't keep it on for more than a few seconds now!
timer.end: Just as you feel your neck is about to snap, you take off your helmet.

fireWalls._note: Jump-through: the player leaps over the flames (human_longjump, fire_jump), held for 23 ticks, then takes 5 damage as the camera comes back. The two recorded jumps into the Being's ring also pan the camera. Ticks 3517-3540, 4123-4146, 5571-5594.
fireWalls.tooHot: The flames are too hot in the centre!
fireWalls.leap: You close your eyes and leap through the flames! Ouch!

avatar._note: After the Being's last line the Avatar appears at 2375,4951 facing the player, with a hint arrow on it (tick 3574).
